attestations.how_we_meet: This system stores all records for Whistlebird and actively follows requirements for NP3 compliance.

We have not had to do this but we can quickly and effectively isolate affected products and stop processes. Our internal system flags non compliant processes which has been tailored towards the alcohol industry so we get a live record and signal of non compliance.

Our internal system was built to trace everything. We integrate with Xero and map batch IDs to sales records so we can see full lineage from source ingredient through to all stores that have taken our stock.

evidence_fields.trace_result: Batch IDs are mapped to Xero sales records, giving full lineage from source ingredient to every store that has taken stock

attestations.how_we_meet: This system has routine checks that flag when reviews are done which is set per check. We have not had any issues since we have always used in house systems like this to prevent issues and there are only 2 of us that own and operate this so it's easy to stay on top of.

evidence_fields.record_register_location: Compliant NP3 register and Core execution evidence

attestations.how_we_meet: Staff training and competency is recorded in the training register on this check: each training category is logged per person with the date it was completed, and the register table shows the latest date for each person.

evidence_fields.training_register_reference: Staff training register on this check (training category, person and date)

attestations.how_we_meet: Both of us perform all duties in the business. We are both across cross contamination and hygiene protocols and stay away if sick - since we are part time we do not have set 'days' for work.
Areas for improvement from last verification noted and actioned - obtained first aid kit and completed recall simulation.

evidence_fields.follow_up_status: Areas for improvement from last verification noted and actioned: first aid kit obtained and recall simulation completed

attestations.how_we_meet: Staff follow cross contamination and hygiene protocols, handwashing, wear clean clothes and wear new and clean gloves when handling food.

evidence_fields.hygiene_procedure: Hand washing and clean clothing procedure

attestations.how_we_meet: We stay away from work if we are sick, since there are only 2 of us this is easy to manage and this system flags on every check now when they are up for review which prompts us to re-evaluate if our processes are still fit for purpose.

evidence_fields.illness_procedure: Keeping away from food when sick procedure

attestations.how_we_meet: We only use raw ingredients in our products, none of which are allergens.

Chemicals and food are stored in separate contained containers. Food is stored in air tight containers individually per ingredient to avoid cross contamination. Food processing areas are cleaned before food processing is done and food handling is done with new and clean gloves and we wear clean clothing to reduce the chance of issues here.
We distill our Gin above 78°C for a couple of hours per distillation, this is well above the minimum time at temperature to avoid issues.

evidence_fields.critical_limit: Distillation above 78°C for a couple of hours per distillation

attestations.how_we_meet: Staff follow cross contamination and hygiene protocols, handwashing, wear clean clothes and wear new and clean gloves when handling food.

evidence_fields.control_method: Keeping foods separate in the food preparation area
